⏺ Bash(tracker-cli --help 2>&1 | head -30; echo "---"; tracker-cli create --help 2>&1 | head -30)
  ⎿  Usage: tracker-cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND

     Lightweight issue tracking for projects.

     Project:
       --tracker-dir VALUE     Override beads directory path
       --tracker-file VALUE    Override beads file path

     Options:
       -q, --quiet    Suppress status footer

     Output:
       --json    Output as JSON

     Commands:
       create    Create a new bead
       show      Show full bead details
       import    Import an org heading from a file as a bead
       move      Move a bead to another tracker project

     Lifecycle:
       update     Update bead fields
       advance    Advance bead to next workflow step
       close      Close a bead with resolution
       claim      Claim a bead for active work
       delete     Permanently delete beads
       archive    Archive beads to archive file

       Sections (update, advance, close):
         --design VALUE                 Set Design section
     ---
     Usage: tracker-cli create [OPTIONS] <title>

     Create a new bead

     Arguments:
       <title>    Bead title

     Options:
       -p, --priority VALUE       Priority (choices: A, B, C, D, E)
       -a, --assignee VALUE       Assignee name
       -d, --description VALUE    Description text
       --parent VALUE             Parent bead ID
       --discovered-from VALUE    Source bead ID
       --blocked-by VALUE ...     Blocked-by bead IDs
       --related VALUE ...        Related bead IDs
       --duplicate-of VALUE       Duplicate-of bead ID
       --static                   Mark bead as static (no workflow)
       -n, --name VALUE           Assign a name (alias) to the bead

     Global Options:
       --tracker-dir VALUE     Override beads directory path
       --tracker-file VALUE    Override beads file path
       -q, --quiet            Suppress status footer
       --json                 Output as JSON

     Search beads by text pattern

     Global Options:

       --blocked                 Show only blocked beads
